after.summary: One of Russia’s best-known street artists, Slava Ptrk (Stanislav Komissarov), posted an Instagram photo of a new work exploring his own experience in exile. Komissarov left Russia after its full-scale invasion of Ukraine began in 2022. Russian authorities designated him a “foreign agent.” The work, “Ne nuzhen tam / Ne nuzhen tut” (“Unwanted There / Unwanted Here”), is also called “Promezhutochnye itogi chetyrekh let emigratsii” (“Four Years in Exile: An Interim Assessment”). It read “I Miss You.”
